Explore the stunning luxury home at 1304 Overlook Ridge Drive in Belton, TX 76513! In this video, you'll get an exclusive tour of this custom-built, 6,000 sq. ft. property, featuring six spacious bedrooms and six full bathrooms and an infinity pool! Located in the heart of Central Texas, this beautiful home combines elegance with modern design. Don’t miss out on discovering everything this desirable location has to offer. Be sure to watch the full video, like, and subscribe for more luxury home tours and updates on the Central Texas real estate market.
